text:
QUOTE: "If it is the current channel, kick the user out with `CHANNEL_ARCHIVED`; then remove the user from the channel" (row 1, '`'false'`' column) and "After the server call, set `delete_at` to now and keep the channel | Remove the current user from the channel instead" (row 2)
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that when archived channels aren't viewable the user is removed (kicked out if current), and when viewable the channel is kept and marked archived via `delete_at`.
